title: 80% Of Known Animal Species Are Insects
hook: Eight in 10 known animal species are insects.
closing: Most insect species remain unnamed, so this planet is still largely unexplored.
question: What insect surprises you most?

segments.say: Insects make up 80% of known animal species. Humans live on a planet dominated by six-legged life.
Beetles alone may total 1.5 million species. One insect group dwarfs entire vertebrate classes.
Scientists estimate 5.5 million insect species exist. Most still have no scientific name.
